[&amp;_a]:border-current [&amp;_strong]:!text-current text-blue-800 dark:text-blue-300" data-component-part="callout-content"><span data-as="p"><strong>For Organization Admins:</strong> This page is for managing credentials across multiple workspaces. To use AI models in your workspace, see the <a class="link" href="/docs/product/model-catalog">Model Catalog</a> documentation.</span></div></div>
<span data-as="p"><strong>What are Integrations?</strong>
A place to store credentials once and share them with multiple workspaces.</span>
<span data-as="p"><strong>Why use them?</strong></span>
<ul>
<li><strong>Save time:</strong> Store API keys once, use in many workspaces</li>
<li><strong>Control access:</strong> Decide which workspaces can use which credentials</li>
<li><strong>Control models:</strong> Enable or disable specific models at the Integration level</li>
<li><strong>Set limits:</strong> Different budgets and rate limits per workspace</li>
</ul>
<span data-as="p"><strong>How it works:</strong></span>
<ol>
<li>Store credentials here (creates an Integration)</li>
<li>Choose which models are available (enable/disable models)</li>
<li>Share with workspaces (they see it as a Provider in their Model Catalog)</li>
<li>Each workspace can use the same credentials with different limits, but only access models you’ve enabled</li>
</ol>
<span data-as="p"><strong>Simple analogy:</strong> Like a shared password vault. Store your OpenAI API key once, then share it with multiple workspaces. Each workspace can use the same credentials but with different budgets and rate limits.</span>
<span data-as="p">When you create an Integration, you control:</span>
<ul>
<li><strong>Who</strong> can use these credentials (which workspaces)</li>
<li><strong>What</strong> models they can access</li>
<li><strong>How much</strong> they can spend (budget limits)</li>
<li><strong>How fast</strong> they can make requests (rate limits)</li>
</ul>
<h2 class="flex whitespace-pre-wrap group font-semibold" id="why-use-integrations"><div class="absolute" tabindex="-1"><a href="#why-use-integrations" class="-ml-10 flex items-center opacity-0 border-0 group-hover:opacity-100 focus:opacity-100 focus:outline-0 group/link" aria-label="Navigate to header">​<div class="w-6 h-6 rounded-md flex items-center justify-center shadow-sm text-gray-400 dark:text-white/50 dark:bg-background-dark dark:brightness-[1.35] dark:ring-1 dark:hover:brightness-150 bg-white ring-1 ring-gray-400/30 dark:ring-gray-700/25 hover:ring-gray-400/60 dark:hover:ring-white/20 group-focus/link:border-2 group-focus/link:border-primary dark:group-focus/link:border-primary-light"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" fill="gray" height="12px" viewBox="0 0 576 512"><path d="M0 256C0 167.6 71.6 96 160 96h72c13.3 0 24 10.7 24 24s-10.7 24-24 24H160C98.1 144 48 194.1 48 256s50.1 112 112 112h72c13.3 0 24 10.7 24 24s-10.7 24-24 24H160C71.6 416 0 344.4 0 256zm576 0c0 88.4-71.6 160-160 160H344c-13.3 0-24-10.7-24-24s10.7-24 24-24h72c61.9 0 112-50.1 112-112s-50.1-112-112-112H344c-13.3 0-24-10.7-24-24s10.7-24 24-24h72c88.4 0 160 71.6 160 160zM184 232H392c13.3 0 24 10.7 24 24s-10.7 24-24 24H184c-13.3 0-24-10.7-24-24s10.7-24 24-24z"></path></svg></div></a></div><span class="cursor-pointer">Why Use Integrations?</span></h2>
<span data-as="p">Instead of each workspace entering the same API keys separately, store them once and share them:</span>
<ol>
<li><strong>Save time</strong> - No need to re-enter credentials in each workspace</li>
<li><strong>Control access</strong> - Decide which workspaces can use which credentials</li>
<li><strong>Set limits</strong> - Different budgets and rate limits per workspace</li>
<li><strong>Stay secure</strong> - API keys are encrypted and never exposed to end users</li>
<li><strong>Track everything</strong> - See usage and costs across all workspaces</li>
</ol>
<h2 class="flex whitespace-pre-wrap group font-semibold" id="understanding-the-integrations-dashboard"><div class="absolute" tabindex="-1"><a href="#understanding-the-integrations-dashboard" class="-ml-10 flex items-center opacity-0 border-0 group-hover:opacity-100 focus:opacity-100 focus:outline-0 group/link" aria-label="Navigate to header">​<div class="w-6 h-6 rounded-md flex items-center justify-center shadow-sm text-gray-400 dark:text-white/50 dark:bg-background-dark dark:brightness-[1.35] dark:ring-1 dark:hover:brightness-150 bg-white ring-1 ring-gray-400/30 dark:ring-gray-700/25 hover:ring-gray-400/60 dark:hover:ring-white/20 group-focus/link:border-2 group-focus/link:border-primary dark:group-focus/link:border-primary-light"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" fill="gray" height="12px" viewBox="0 0 576 512"><path d="M0 256C0 167.6 71.6 96 160 96h72c13.3 0 24 10.7 24 24s-10.7 24-24 24H160C98.1 144 48 194.1 48 256s50.1 112 112 112h72c13.3 0 24 10.7 24 24s-10.7 24-24 24H160C71.6 416 0 344.4 0 256zm576 0c0 88.4-71.6 160-160 160H344c-13.3 0-24-10.7-24-24s10.7-24 24-24h72c61.9 0 112-50.1 112-112s-50.1-112-112-112H344c-13.3 0-24-10.7-24-24s10.7-24 24-24h72c88.4 0 160 71.6 160 160zM184 232H392c13.3 0 24 10.7 24 24s-10.7 24-24 24H184c-13.3 0-24-10.7-24-24s10.7-24 24-24z"></path></svg></div></a></div><span class="cursor-pointer">Understanding the Integrations Dashboard</span></h2>
<span data-as="p">Navigate to the <a href="https://app.portkey.ai/integrations" target="_blank" rel="noreferrer" class="link">Integrations page</a> in your Portkey organization settings. The page is organized into three tabs, each serving a distinct purpose:</span>
<ul>
<li><strong><code>All</code></strong>: This is a comprehensive list of all 50+ providers Portkey supports. This is your starting point for connecting a new provider to your organization.</li>
<li><strong><code>Connected</code></strong>: This tab lists all the integrations that you have personally connected at the organization level. It’s your primary view for managing your centrally-governed providers.</li>
<li><strong><code>Workspace-Created</code></strong>: This tab gives you complete visibility and governance over any integrations created <em>by Workspace Admins</em> for their specific workspaces. It ensures that even with delegated control, you maintain a full audit trail and can manage these instances if needed.</li>
</ul>

<h1 class="flex whitespace-pre-wrap group font-semibold text-2xl sm:text-3xl mt-8" id="configuring-your-integration-access-&amp;-limits"><div class="absolute" tabindex="-1"><a href="#configuring-your-integration-access-&amp;-limits" class="-ml-10 flex items-center opacity-0 border-0 group-hover:opacity-100 focus:opacity-100 focus:outline-0 group/link" aria-label="Navigate to header">​<div class="w-6 h-6 rounded-md flex items-center justify-center shadow-sm text-gray-400 dark:text-white/50 dark:bg-background-dark dark:brightness-[1.35] dark:ring-1 dark:hover:brightness-150 bg-white ring-1 ring-gray-400/30 dark:ring-gray-700/25 hover:ring-gray-400/60 dark:hover:ring-white/20 group-focus/link:border-2 group-focus/link:border-primary dark:group-focus/link:border-primary-light"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" fill="gray" height="12px" viewBox="0 0 576 512"><path d="M0 256C0 167.6 71.6 96 160 96h72c13.3 0 24 10.7 24 24s-10.7 24-24 24H160C98.1 144 48 194.1 48 256s50.1 112 112 112h72c13.3 0 24 10.7 24 24s-10.7 24-24 24H160C71.6 416 0 344.4 0 256zm576 0c0 88.4-71.6 160-160 160H344c-13.3 0-24-10.7-24-24s10.7-24 24-24h72c61.9 0 112-50.1 112-112s-50.1-112-112-112H344c-13.3 0-24-10.7-24-24s10.7-24 24-24h72c88.4 0 160 71.6 160 160zM184 232H392c13.3 0 24 10.7 24 24s-10.7 24-24 24H184c-13.3 0-24-10.7-24-24s10.7-24 24-24z"></path></svg></div></a></div><span class="cursor-pointer">Configuring Your Integration Access &amp; Limits</span></h1>
<span data-as="p">After creating your Integration, you’ll need to configure three key aspects that work together to control access and usage:</span>
<h2 class="flex whitespace-pre-wrap group font-semibold" id="1-workspace-provisioning"><div class="absolute" tabindex="-1"><a href="#1-workspace-provisioning" class="-ml-10 flex items-center opacity-0 border-0 group-hover:opacity-100 focus:opacity-100 focus:outline-0 group/link" aria-label="Navigate to header">​<div class="w-6 h-6 rounded-md flex items-center justify-center shadow-sm text-gray-400 dark:text-white/50 dark:bg-background-dark dark:brightness-[1.35] dark:ring-1 dark:hover:brightness-150 bg-white ring-1 ring-gray-400/30 dark:ring-gray-700/25 hover:ring-gray-400/60 dark:hover:ring-white/20 group-focus/link:border-2 group-focus/link:border-primary dark:group-focus/link:border-primary-light"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" fill="gray" height="12px" viewBox="0 0 576 512"><path d="M0 256C0 167.6 71.6 96 160 96h72c13.3 0 24 10.7 24 24s-10.7 24-24 24H160C98.1 144 48 194.1 48 256s50.1 112 112 112h72c13.3 0 24 10.7 24 24s-10.7 24-24 24H160C71.6 416 0 344.4 0 256zm576 0c0 88.4-71.6 160-160 160H344c-13.3 0-24-10.7-24-24s10.7-24 24-24h72c61.9 0 112-50.1 112-112s-50.1-112-112-112H344c-13.3 0-24-10.7-24-24s10.7-24 24-24h72c88.4 0 160 71.6 160 160zM184 232H392c13.3 0 24 10.7 24 24s-10.7 24-24 24H184c-13.3 0-24-10.7-24-24s10.7-24 24-24z"></path></svg></div></a></div><span class="cursor-pointer">1. Workspace Provisioning</span></h2>
<span data-as="p">Workspace provisioning determines which teams and projects can access this Integration. This is crucial for maintaining security boundaries and ensuring teams only access approved AI resources.</span>
<h4 class="flex whitespace-pre-wrap group font-semibold" id="how-it-works"><div class="absolute" tabindex="-1"><a href="#how-it-works" class="-ml-10 flex items-center opacity-0 border-0 group-hover:opacity-100 focus:opacity-100 focus:outline-0 group/link" aria-label="Navigate to header">​<div class="w-6 h-6 rounded-md flex items-center justify-center shadow-sm text-gray-400 dark:text-white/50 dark:bg-background-dark dark:brightness-[1.35] dark:ring-1 dark:hover:brightness-150 bg-white ring-1 ring-gray-400/30 dark:ring-gray-700/25 hover:ring-gray-400/60 dark:hover:ring-white/20 group-focus/link:border-2 group-focus/link:border-primary dark:group-focus/link:border-primary-light"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" fill="gray" height="12px" viewBox="0 0 576 512"><path d="M0 256C0 167.6 71.6 96 160 96h72c13.3 0 24 10.7 24 24s-10.7 24-24 24H160C98.1 144 48 194.1 48 256s50.1 112 112 112h72c13.3 0 24 10.7 24 24s-10.7 24-24 24H160C71.6 416 0 344.4 0 256zm576 0c0 88.4-71.6 160-160 160H344c-13.3 0-24-10.7-24-24s10.7-24 24-24h72c61.9 0 112-50.1 112-112s-50.1-112-112-112H344c-13.3 0-24-10.7-24-24s10.7-24 24-24h72c88.4 0 160 71.6 160 160zM184 232H392c13.3 0 24 10.7 24 24s-10.7 24-24 24H184c-13.3 0-24-10.7-24-24s10.7-24 24-24z"></path></svg></div></a></div><span class="cursor-pointer">How It Works</span></h4>
<span data-as="p">When you share credentials with a workspace:</span>
<ol>
<li>That workspace sees it as an <strong>AI Provider</strong> in their Model Catalog</li>
<li>They can use it immediately - no need to enter credentials again</li>
<li>Set different budgets/rate limits for each workspace</li>
<li>Revoke access anytime</li>
</ol>
<h4 class="flex whitespace-pre-wrap group font-semibold" id="setting-up-workspace-provisioning"><div class="absolute" tabindex="-1"><a href="#setting-up-workspace-provisioning" class="-ml-10 flex items-center opacity-0 border-0 group-hover:opacity-100 focus:opacity-100 focus:outline-0 group/link" aria-label="Navigate to header">​<div class="w-6 h-6 rounded-md flex items-center justify-center shadow-sm text-gray-400 dark:text-white/50 dark:bg-background-dark dark:brightness-[1.35] dark:ring-1 dark:hover:brightness-150 bg-white ring-1 ring-gray-400/30 dark:ring-gray-700/25 hover:ring-gray-400/60 dark:hover:ring-white/20 group-focus/link:border-2 group-focus/link:border-primary dark:group-focus/link:border-primary-light"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" fill="gray" height="12px" viewBox="0 0 576 512"><path d="M0 256C0 167.6 71.6 96 160 96h72c13.3 0 24 10.7 24 24s-10.7 24-24 24H160C98.1 144 48 194.1 48 256s50.1 112 112 112h72c13.3 0 24 10.7 24 24s-10.7 24-24 24H160C71.6 416 0 344.4 0 256zm576 0c0 88.4-71.6 160-160 160H344c-13.3 0-24-10.7-24-24s10.7-24 24-24h72c61.9 0 112-50.1 112-112s-50.1-112-112-112H344c-13.3 0-24-10.7-24-24s10.7-24 24-24h72c88.4 0 160 71.6 160 160zM184 232H392c13.3 0 24 10.7 24 24s-10.7 24-24 24H184c-13.3 0-24-10.7-24-24s10.7-24 24-24z"></path></svg></div></a></div><span class="cursor-pointer">Setting Up Workspace Provisioning</span></h4>

<ol>
<li>In your Integration settings, navigate to <strong>Workspace Provisioning</strong></li>
<li>Select which workspaces should have access:<!-- -->
<ul>
<li><strong>All Workspaces</strong>: Grants access to every workspace in your organization</li>
<li><strong>Specific Workspaces</strong>: Choose individual workspaces that need access</li>
</ul>
</li>
<li>For each workspace, click the <code>Edit Budget &amp; Rate Limits</code> <svg class="icon inline bg-gray-800 dark:bg-gray-100" style="-webkit-mask-image:url(https://d3gk2c5xim1je2.cloudfront.net/v7.1.0/regular/pen-to-square.svg);-webkit-mask-repeat:no-repeat;-webkit-mask-position:center;mask-image:url(https://d3gk2c5xim1je2.cloudfront.net/v7.1.0/regular/pen-to-square.svg);mask-repeat:no-repeat;mask-position:center;width:24px;height:24px;display:inline-block;vertical-align:middle"></svg> icon to configure:<!-- -->
<ul>
<li>Custom budget limits (see Budget Limits section below)</li>
<li>Custom rate limits (see Rate Limits section below)</li>
<li>Specific model access</li>
</ul>
</li>
</ol>
<h4 class="flex whitespace-pre-wrap group font-semibold" id="best-practices"><div class="absolute" tabindex="-1"><a href="#best-practices" class="-ml-10 flex items-center opacity-0 border-0 group-hover:opacity-100 focus:opacity-100 focus:outline-0 group/link" aria-label="Navigate to header">​<div class="w-6 h-6 rounded-md flex items-center justify-center shadow-sm text-gray-400 dark:text-white/50 dark:bg-background-dark dark:brightness-[1.35] dark:ring-1 dark:hover:brightness-150 bg-white ring-1 ring-gray-400/30 dark:ring-gray-700/25 hover:ring-gray-400/60 dark:hover:ring-white/20 group-focus/link:border-2 group-focus/link:border-primary dark:group-focus/link:border-primary-light"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" fill="gray" height="12px" viewBox="0 0 576 512"><path d="M0 256C0 167.6 71.6 96 160 96h72c13.3 0 24 10.7 24 24s-10.7 24-24 24H160C98.1 144 48 194.1 48 256s50.1 112 112 112h72c13.3 0 24 10.7 24 24s-10.7 24-24 24H160C71.6 416 0 344.4 0 256zm576 0c0 88.4-71.6 160-160 160H344c-13.3 0-24-10.7-24-24s10.7-24 24-24h72c61.9 0 112-50.1 112-112s-50.1-112-112-112H344c-13.3 0-24-10.7-24-24s10.7-24 24-24h72c88.4 0 160 71.6 160 160zM184 232H392c13.3 0 24 10.7 24 24s-10.7 24-24 24H184c-13.3 0-24-10.7-24-24s10.7-24 24-24z"></path></svg></div></a></div><span class="cursor-pointer">Best Practices</span></h4>
<ul>
<li><strong>Principle of Least Privilege</strong>: Only provision to workspaces that genuinely need access</li>
<li><strong>Environment Separation</strong>: Create separate Integrations for dev/staging/production</li>
<li><strong>Regular Audits</strong>: Review workspace provisioning quarterly to remove unnecessary access</li>
</ul>
<hr/>
<h2 class="flex whitespace-pre-wrap group font-semibold" id="2-model-provisioning"><div class="absolute" tabindex="-1"><a href="#2-model-provisioning" class="-ml-10 flex items-center opacity-0 border-0 group-hover:opacity-100 focus:opacity-100 focus:outline-0 group/link" aria-label="Navigate to header">​<div class="w-6 h-6 rounded-md flex items-center justify-center shadow-sm text-gray-400 dark:text-white/50 dark:bg-background-dark dark:brightness-[1.35] dark:ring-1 dark:hover:brightness-150 bg-white ring-1 ring-gray-400/30 dark:ring-gray-700/25 hover:ring-gray-400/60 dark:hover:ring-white/20 group-focus/link:border-2 group-focus/link:border-primary dark:group-focus/link:border-primary-light"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" fill="gray" height="12px" viewBox="0 0 576 512"><path d="M0 256C0 167.6 71.6 96 160 96h72c13.3 0 24 10.7 24 24s-10.7 24-24 24H160C98.1 144 48 194.1 48 256s50.1 112 112 112h72c13.3 0 24 10.7 24 24s-10.7 24-24 24H160C71.6 416 0 344.4 0 256zm576 0c0 88.4-71.6 160-160 160H344c-13.3 0-24-10.7-24-24s10.7-24 24-24h72c61.9 0 112-50.1 112-112s-50.1-112-112-112H344c-13.3 0-24-10.7-24-24s10.7-24 24-24h72c88.4 0 160 71.6 160 160zM184 232H392c13.3 0 24 10.7 24 24s-10.7 24-24 24H184c-13.3 0-24-10.7-24-24s10.7-24 24-24z"></path></svg></div></a></div><span class="cursor-pointer">2. Model Provisioning</span></h2>
<span data-as="p"><strong>Model lists are tied to Integrations.</strong> When you create an Integration, you control which models are available. All Providers created from that Integration will only have access to the models you’ve enabled.</span>
<span data-as="p">This is essential for:</span>
<ul>
<li><strong>Controlling costs:</strong> Restrict access to expensive models</li>
<li><strong>Ensuring compliance:</strong> Limit models to approved ones</li>
<li><strong>Maintaining consistency:</strong> Standardize model usage across teams</li>
</ul>
<h4 class="flex whitespace-pre-wrap group font-semibold" id="setting-up-model-provisioning"><div class="absolute" tabindex="-1"><a href="#setting-up-model-provisioning" class="-ml-10 flex items-center opacity-0 border-0 group-hover:opacity-100 focus:opacity-100 focus:outline-0 group/link" aria-label="Navigate to header">​<div class="w-6 h-6 rounded-md flex items-center justify-center shadow-sm text-gray-400 dark:text-white/50 dark:bg-background-dark dark:brightness-[1.35] dark:ring-1 dark:hover:brightness-150 bg-white ring-1 ring-gray-400/30 dark:ring-gray-700/25 hover:ring-gray-400/60 dark:hover:ring-white/20 group-focus/link:border-2 group-focus/link:border-primary dark:group-focus/link:border-primary-light"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" fill="gray" height="12px" viewBox="0 0 576 512"><path d="M0 256C0 167.6 71.6 96 160 96h72c13.3 0 24 10.7 24 24s-10.7 24-24 24H160C98.1 144 48 194.1 48 256s50.1 112 112 112h72c13.3 0 24 10.7 24 24s-10.7 24-24 24H160C71.6 416 0 344.4 0 256zm576 0c0 88.4-71.6 160-160 160H344c-13.3 0-24-10.7-24-24s10.7-24 24-24h72c61.9 0 112-50.1 112-112s-50.1-112-112-112H344c-13.3 0-24-10.7-24-24s10.7-24 24-24h72c88.4 0 160 71.6 160 160zM184 232H392c13.3 0 24 10.7 24 24s-10.7 24-24 24H184c-13.3 0-24-10.7-24-24s10.7-24 24-24z"></path></svg></div></a></div><span class="cursor-pointer">Setting Up Model Provisioning</span></h4>

<ol>
<li>In your Integration settings, navigate to <strong>Model Provisioning</strong></li>
<li>Select the configuration options:<!-- -->
<ul>
<li><strong>Allow All Models</strong>: Provides access to all models offered by the provider</li>
<li><strong>Allow Specific Models</strong>: Create an allowlist of approved models</li>
</ul>
</li>
</ol>
<span data-as="p"><strong>Important:</strong> The model list you set here applies to all Providers created from this Integration. Workspaces will only see and be able to use the models you’ve enabled.</span>
<h4 class="flex whitespace-pre-wrap group font-semibold" id="advanced-model-management"><div class="absolute" tabindex="-1"><a href="#advanced-model-management" class="-ml-10 flex items-center opacity-0 border-0 group-hover:opacity-100 focus:opacity-100 focus:outline-0 group/link" aria-label="Navigate to header">​<div class="w-6 h-6 rounded-md flex items-center justify-center shadow-sm text-gray-400 dark:text-white/50 dark:bg-background-dark dark:brightness-[1.35] dark:ring-1 dark:hover:brightness-150 bg-white ring-1 ring-gray-400/30 dark:ring-gray-700/25 hover:ring-gray-400/60 dark:hover:ring-white/20 group-focus/link:border-2 group-focus/link:border-primary dark:group-focus/link:border-primary-light"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" fill="gray" height="12px" viewBox="0 0 576 512"><path d="M0 256C0 167.6 71.6 96 160 96h72c13.3 0 24 10.7 24 24s-10.7 24-24 24H160C98.1 144 48 194.1 48 256s50.1 112 112 112h72c13.3 0 24 10.7 24 24s-10.7 24-24 24H160C71.6 416 0 344.4 0 256zm576 0c0 88.4-71.6 160-160 160H344c-13.3 0-24-10.7-24-24s10.7-24 24-24h72c61.9 0 112-50.1 112-112s-50.1-112-112-112H344c-13.3 0-24-10.7-24-24s10.7-24 24-24h72c88.4 0 160 71.6 160 160zM184 232H392c13.3 0 24 10.7 24 24s-10.7 24-24 24H184c-13.3 0-24-10.7-24-24s10.7-24 24-24z"></path></svg></div></a></div><span class="cursor-pointer">Advanced Model Management</span></h4>
<h3 class="flex whitespace-pre-wrap group font-semibold" id="custom-models"><div class="absolute" tabindex="-1"><a href="#custom-models" class="-ml-10 flex items-center opacity-0 border-0 group-hover:opacity-100 focus:opacity-100 focus:outline-0 group/link" aria-label="Navigate to header">​<div class="w-6 h-6 rounded-md flex items-center justify-center shadow-sm text-gray-400 dark:text-white/50 dark:bg-background-dark dark:brightness-[1.35] dark:ring-1 dark:hover:brightness-150 bg-white ring-1 ring-gray-400/30 dark:ring-gray-700/25 hover:ring-gray-400/60 dark:hover:ring-white/20 group-focus/link:border-2 group-focus/link:border-primary dark:group-focus/link:border-primary-light"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" fill="gray" height="12px" viewBox="0 0 576 512"><path d="M0 256C0 167.6 71.6 96 160 96h72c13.3 0 24 10.7 24 24s-10.7 24-24 24H160C98.1 144 48 194.1 48 256s50.1 112 112 112h72c13.3 0 24 10.7 24 24s-10.7 24-24 24H160C71.6 416 0 344.4 0 256zm576 0c0 88.4-71.6 160-160 160H344c-13.3 0-24-10.7-24-24s10.7-24 24-24h72c61.9 0 112-50.1 112-112s-50.1-112-112-112H344c-13.3 0-24-10.7-24-24s10.7-24 24-24h72c88.4 0 160 71.6 160 160zM184 232H392c13.3 0 24 10.7 24 24s-10.7 24-24 24H184c-13.3 0-24-10.7-24-24s10.7-24 24-24z"></path></svg></div></a></div><span class="cursor-pointer">Custom Models</span></h3>
<span data-as="p">The Model Catalog isn’t limited to standard provider models. You can add:</span>
<ul>
<li><strong>Fine-tuned models</strong>: Your custom OpenAI or Anthropic fine-tunes</li>
<li><strong>Self-hosted models</strong>: Models running on your infrastructure</li>
<li><strong>Private models</strong>: Internal models not publicly available</li>
</ul>
<span data-as="p">Each custom model gets the same governance controls as standard models.</span>
<div class="card block font-normal group relative my-2 ring-2 ring-transparent rounded-2xl bg-white dark:bg-background-dark border border-gray-950/10 dark:border-white/10 overflow-hidden w-full cursor-pointer hover:!border-primary dark:hover:!border-primary-light" tabindex="0" role="link"><div class="px-6 py-5 relative" data-component-part="card-content-container"><div id="card-link-arrow-icon" class="absolute text-gray-400 dark:text-gray-500 group-hover:text-primary dark:group-hover:text-primary-light top-5 right-5 hidden"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-arrow-up-right size-4"><path d="M7 7h10v10"></path><path d="M7 17 17 7"></path></svg></div><div class="size-6 fill-gray-800 dark:fill-gray-100 text-gray-800 dark:text-gray-100" data-component-part="card-icon"><svg class="size-6 !m-0 shrink-0 bg-primary dark:bg-primary-light" style="-webkit-mask-image:url(https://d3gk2c5xim1je2.cloudfront.net/v7.1.0/regular/wrench.svg);-webkit-mask-repeat:no-repeat;-webkit-mask-position:center;mask-image:url(https://d3gk2c5xim1je2.cloudfront.net/v7.1.0/regular/wrench.svg);mask-repeat:no-repeat;mask-position:center"></svg></div><div class="w-full"><h2 class="not-prose font-semibold text-base text-gray-800 dark:text-white mt-4" contentEditable="false" data-component-part="card-title">Custom Models</h2><div class="prose mt-1 font-normal text-base leading-6 text-gray-600 dark:text-gray-400" data-component-part="card-content"><span data-as="p">Add and manage your fine-tuned, self-hosted, or private models</span></div></div></div></div>
<h3 class="flex whitespace-pre-wrap group font-semibold" id="overriding-model-details-custom-pricing"><div class="absolute" tabindex="-1"><a href="#overriding-model-details-custom-pricing" class="-ml-10 flex items-center opacity-0 border-0 group-hover:opacity-100 focus:opacity-100 focus:outline-0 group/link" aria-label="Navigate to header">​<div class="w-6 h-6 rounded-md flex items-center justify-center shadow-sm text-gray-400 dark:text-white/50 dark:bg-background-dark dark:brightness-[1.35] dark:ring-1 dark:hover:brightness-150 bg-white ring-1 ring-gray-400/30 dark:ring-gray-700/25 hover:ring-gray-400/60 dark:hover:ring-white/20 group-focus/link:border-2 group-focus/link:border-primary dark:group-focus/link:border-primary-light"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" fill="gray" height="12px" viewBox="0 0 576 512"><path d="M0 256C0 167.6 71.6 96 160 96h72c13.3 0 24 10.7 24 24s-10.7 24-24 24H160C98.1 144 48 194.1 48 256s50.1 112 112 112h72c13.3 0 24 10.7 24 24s-10.7 24-24 24H160C71.6 416 0 344.4 0 256zm576 0c0 88.4-71.6 160-160 160H344c-13.3 0-24-10.7-24-24s10.7-24 24-24h72c61.9 0 112-50.1 112-112s-50.1-112-112-112H344c-13.3 0-24-10.7-24-24s10.7-24 24-24h72c88.4 0 160 71.6 160 160zM184 232H392c13.3 0 24 10.7 24 24s-10.7 24-24 24H184c-13.3 0-24-10.7-24-24s10.7-24 24-24z"></path></svg></div></a></div><span class="cursor-pointer">Overriding Model Details (Custom Pricing)</span></h3>
<span data-as="p">Override default model pricing for:</span>
<ul>
<li><strong>Negotiated rates</strong>: If you have enterprise agreements with providers</li>
<li><strong>Internal chargebacks</strong>: Set custom rates for internal cost allocation</li>
<li><strong>Free tier models</strong>: Mark certain models as free for specific teams</li>
</ul>
<span data-as="p">Custom pricing ensures your cost tracking accurately reflects your actual spend.</span>
<div class="card block font-normal group relative my-2 ring-2 ring-transparent rounded-2xl bg-white dark:bg-background-dark border border-gray-950/10 dark:border-white/10 overflow-hidden w-full cursor-pointer hover:!border-primary dark:hover:!border-primary-light" tabindex="0" role="link"><div class="px-6 py-5 relative" data-component-part="card-content-container"><div id="card-link-arrow-icon" class="absolute text-gray-400 dark:text-gray-500 group-hover:text-primary dark:group-hover:text-primary-light top-5 right-5 hidden"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-arrow-up-right size-4"><path d="M7 7h10v10"></path><path d="M7 17 17 7"></path></svg></div><div class="size-6 fill-gray-800 dark:fill-gray-100 text-gray-800 dark:text-gray-100" data-component-part="card-icon"><svg class="size-6 !m-0 shrink-0 bg-primary dark:bg-primary-light" style="-webkit-mask-image:url(https://d3gk2c5xim1je2.cloudfront.net/v7.1.0/regular/tag.svg);-webkit-mask-repeat:no-repeat;-webkit-mask-position:center;mask-image:url(https://d3gk2c5xim1je2.cloudfront.net/v7.1.0/regular/tag.svg);mask-repeat:no-repeat;mask-position:center"></svg></div><div class="w-full"><h2 class="not-prose font-semibold text-base text-gray-800 dark:text-white mt-4" contentEditable="false" data-component-part="card-title">Custom Pricing</h2><div class="prose mt-1 font-normal text-base leading-6 text-gray-600 dark:text-gray-400" data-component-part="card-content"><span data-as="p">Configure custom pricing for models with special rates</span></div></div></div></div>

<h3 class="flex whitespace-pre-wrap group font-semibold" id="budget-limits"><div class="absolute" tabindex="-1"><a href="#budget-limits" class="-ml-10 flex items-center opacity-0 border-0 group-hover:opacity-100 focus:opacity-100 focus:outline-0 group/link" aria-label="Navigate to header">​<div class="w-6 h-6 rounded-md flex items-center justify-center shadow-sm text-gray-400 dark:text-white/50 dark:bg-background-dark dark:brightness-[1.35] dark:ring-1 dark:hover:brightness-150 bg-white ring-1 ring-gray-400/30 dark:ring-gray-700/25 hover:ring-gray-400/60 dark:hover:ring-white/20 group-focus/link:border-2 group-focus/link:border-primary dark:group-focus/link:border-primary-light"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" fill="gray" height="12px" viewBox="0 0 576 512"><path d="M0 256C0 167.6 71.6 96 160 96h72c13.3 0 24 10.7 24 24s-10.7 24-24 24H160C98.1 144 48 194.1 48 256s50.1 112 112 112h72c13.3 0 24 10.7 24 24s-10.7 24-24 24H160C71.6 416 0 344.4 0 256zm576 0c0 88.4-71.6 160-160 160H344c-13.3 0-24-10.7-24-24s10.7-24 24-24h72c61.9 0 112-50.1 112-112s-50.1-112-112-112H344c-13.3 0-24-10.7-24-24s10.7-24 24-24h72c88.4 0 160 71.6 160 160zM184 232H392c13.3 0 24 10.7 24 24s-10.7 24-24 24H184c-13.3 0-24-10.7-24-24s10.7-24 24-24z"></path></svg></div></a></div><span class="cursor-pointer">Budget Limits</span></h3>
<span data-as="p"><strong>Budget Limits on Integrations</strong> provide a simple way to manage your spending on AI providers (and LLMs) - giving you confidence and control over your application’s costs. They act as financial guardrails, preventing unexpected AI costs across your organization. These limits cascade down to all AI Providers created from this Integration.</span>
<h4 class="flex whitespace-pre-wrap group font-semibold" id="setting-budget-limits"><div class="absolute" tabindex="-1"><a href="#setting-budget-limits" class="-ml-10 flex items-center opacity-0 border-0 group-hover:opacity-100 focus:opacity-100 focus:outline-0 group/link" aria-label="Navigate to header">​<div class="w-6 h-6 rounded-md flex items-center justify-center shadow-sm text-gray-400 dark:text-white/50 dark:bg-background-dark dark:brightness-[1.35] dark:ring-1 dark:hover:brightness-150 bg-white ring-1 ring-gray-400/30 dark:ring-gray-700/25 hover:ring-gray-400/60 dark:hover:ring-white/20 group-focus/link:border-2 group-focus/link:border-primary dark:group-focus/link:border-primary-light"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" fill="gray" height="12px" viewBox="0 0 576 512"><path d="M0 256C0 167.6 71.6 96 160 96h72c13.3 0 24 10.7 24 24s-10.7 24-24 24H160C98.1 144 48 194.1 48 256s50.1 112 112 112h72c13.3 0 24 10.7 24 24s-10.7 24-24 24H160C71.6 416 0 344.4 0 256zm576 0c0 88.4-71.6 160-160 160H344c-13.3 0-24-10.7-24-24s10.7-24 24-24h72c61.9 0 112-50.1 112-112s-50.1-112-112-112H344c-13.3 0-24-10.7-24-24s10.7-24 24-24h72c88.4 0 160 71.6 160 160zM184 232H392c13.3 0 24 10.7 24 24s-10.7 24-24 24H184c-13.3 0-24-10.7-24-24s10.7-24 24-24z"></path></svg></div></a></div><span class="cursor-pointer">Setting Budget Limits</span></h4>
<ol>
<li>In your Integration settings, navigate to <strong>Workspace Provisioning</strong></li>
<li>Select which workspaces should have access:<!-- -->
<ul>
<li><strong>All Workspaces</strong>: Grants access to every workspace in your organization</li>
<li><strong>Specific Workspaces</strong>: Choose individual workspaces that need access</li>
</ul>
</li>
<li>Click on the  <code>Edit Budget &amp; Rate Limits</code> <svg class="icon inline bg-gray-800 dark:bg-gray-100" style="-webkit-mask-image:url(https://d3gk2c5xim1je2.cloudfront.net/v7.1.0/regular/pen-to-square.svg);-webkit-mask-repeat:no-repeat;-webkit-mask-position:center;mask-image:url(https://d3gk2c5xim1je2.cloudfront.net/v7.1.0/regular/pen-to-square.svg);mask-repeat:no-repeat;mask-position:center;width:24px;height:24px;display:inline-block;vertical-align:middle"></svg> icon to edit the budget limits for the selected workspace</li>
<li>Set your desired budget Limits</li>
<li>Optionally, Select the <code>Apply to every workspace where this integration is enabled</code> checkbox to apply the same budget limits to all workspaces where this integration is enabled</li>
</ol>
<h4 class="flex whitespace-pre-wrap group font-semibold" id="cost-based-limits"><div class="absolute" tabindex="-1"><a href="#cost-based-limits" class="-ml-10 flex items-center opacity-0 border-0 group-hover:opacity-100 focus:opacity-100 focus:outline-0 group/link" aria-label="Navigate to header">​<div class="w-6 h-6 rounded-md flex items-center justify-center shadow-sm text-gray-400 dark:text-white/50 dark:bg-background-dark dark:brightness-[1.35] dark:ring-1 dark:hover:brightness-150 bg-white ring-1 ring-gray-400/30 dark:ring-gray-700/25 hover:ring-gray-400/60 dark:hover:ring-white/20 group-focus/link:border-2 group-focus/link:border-primary dark:group-focus/link:border-primary-light"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" fill="gray" height="12px" viewBox="0 0 576 512"><path d="M0 256C0 167.6 71.6 96 160 96h72c13.3 0 24 10.7 24 24s-10.7 24-24 24H160C98.1 144 48 194.1 48 256s50.1 112 112 112h72c13.3 0 24 10.7 24 24s-10.7 24-24 24H160C71.6 416 0 344.4 0 256zm576 0c0 88.4-71.6 160-160 160H344c-13.3 0-24-10.7-24-24s10.7-24 24-24h72c61.9 0 112-50.1 112-112s-50.1-112-112-112H344c-13.3 0-24-10.7-24-24s10.7-24 24-24h72c88.4 0 160 71.6 160 160zM184 232H392c13.3 0 24 10.7 24 24s-10.7 24-24 24H184c-13.3 0-24-10.7-24-24s10.7-24 24-24z"></path></svg></div></a></div><span class="cursor-pointer">Cost-Based Limits</span></h4>
<span data-as="p">Set a budget limit in USD that, once reached, will automatically expire the key to prevent further usage and overspending.</span>
<h4 class="flex whitespace-pre-wrap group font-semibold" id="token-based-limits"><div class="absolute" tabindex="-1"><a href="#token-based-limits" class="-ml-10 flex items-center opacity-0 border-0 group-hover:opacity-100 focus:opacity-100 focus:outline-0 group/link" aria-label="Navigate to header">​<div class="w-6 h-6 rounded-md flex items-center justify-center shadow-sm text-gray-400 dark:text-white/50 dark:bg-background-dark dark:brightness-[1.35] dark:ring-1 dark:hover:brightness-150 bg-white ring-1 ring-gray-400/30 dark:ring-gray-700/25 hover:ring-gray-400/60 dark:hover:ring-white/20 group-focus/link:border-2 group-focus/link:border-primary dark:group-focus/link:border-primary-light"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" fill="gray" height="12px" viewBox="0 0 576 512"><path d="M0 256C0 167.6 71.6 96 160 96h72c13.3 0 24 10.7 24 24s-10.7 24-24 24H160C98.1 144 48 194.1 48 256s50.1 112 112 112h72c13.3 0 24 10.7 24 24s-10.7 24-24 24H160C71.6 416 0 344.4 0 256zm576 0c0 88.4-71.6 160-160 160H344c-13.3 0-24-10.7-24-24s10.7-24 24-24h72c61.9 0 112-50.1 112-112s-50.1-112-112-112H344c-13.3 0-24-10.7-24-24s10.7-24 24-24h72c88.4 0 160 71.6 160 160zM184 232H392c13.3 0 24 10.7 24 24s-10.7 24-24 24H184c-13.3 0-24-10.7-24-24s10.7-24 24-24z"></path></svg></div></a></div><span class="cursor-pointer">Token-Based Limits</span></h4>
<span data-as="p">Set a maximum number of tokens that can be consumed, allowing you to control usage independent of cost fluctuations.</span>
<blockquote>
<h4 class="flex whitespace-pre-wrap group font-semibold" id="key-considerations-for-budget-limits"><div class="absolute" tabindex="-1"><a href="#key-considerations-for-budget-limits" class="-ml-10 flex items-center opacity-0 border-0 group-hover:opacity-100 focus:opacity-100 focus:outline-0 group/link" aria-label="Navigate to header">​<div class="w-6 h-6 rounded-md flex items-center justify-center shadow-sm text-gray-400 dark:text-white/50 dark:bg-background-dark dark:brightness-[1.35] dark:ring-1 dark:hover:brightness-150 bg-white ring-1 ring-gray-400/30 dark:ring-gray-700/25 hover:ring-gray-400/60 dark:hover:ring-white/20 group-focus/link:border-2 group-focus/link:border-primary dark:group-focus/link:border-primary-light"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" fill="gray" height="12px" viewBox="0 0 576 512"><path d="M0 256C0 167.6 71.6 96 160 96h72c13.3 0 24 10.7 24 24s-10.7 24-24 24H160C98.1 144 48 194.1 48 256s50.1 112 112 112h72c13.3 0 24 10.7 24 24s-10.7 24-24 24H160C71.6 416 0 344.4 0 256zm576 0c0 88.4-71.6 160-160 160H344c-13.3 0-24-10.7-24-24s10.7-24 24-24h72c61.9 0 112-50.1 112-112s-50.1-112-112-112H344c-13.3 0-24-10.7-24-24s10.7-24 24-24h72c88.4 0 160 71.6 160 160zM184 232H392c13.3 0 24 10.7 24 24s-10.7 24-24 24H184c-13.3 0-24-10.7-24-24s10.7-24 24-24z"></path></svg></div></a></div><span class="cursor-pointer">Key Considerations for Budget Limits</span></h4>
<ul>
<li>Budget limits can be set as either cost-based (USD) or token-based</li>
<li>The minimum cost limit you can set is <strong>$1</strong></li>
<li>The minimum token limit you can set is <strong>100 tokens</strong></li>
<li>Budget limits apply until exhausted or reset</li>
<li>Budget limits are applied only to requests made after the limit is set; they do not apply retroactively</li>
<li>Once set, budget limits <strong>cannot be edited</strong> by any organization member</li>
<li>Budget limits work for <strong>all AI provider</strong> created on Portkey using the given <strong>integration</strong></li>
</ul>
</blockquote>
<h4 class="flex whitespace-pre-wrap group font-semibold" id="alert-thresholds"><div class="absolute" tabindex="-1"><a href="#alert-thresholds" class="-ml-10 flex items-center opacity-0 border-0 group-hover:opacity-100 focus:opacity-100 focus:outline-0 group/link" aria-label="Navigate to header">​<div class="w-6 h-6 rounded-md flex items-center justify-center shadow-sm text-gray-400 dark:text-white/50 dark:bg-background-dark dark:brightness-[1.35] dark:ring-1 dark:hover:brightness-150 bg-white ring-1 ring-gray-400/30 dark:ring-gray-700/25 hover:ring-gray-400/60 dark:hover:ring-white/20 group-focus/link:border-2 group-focus/link:border-primary dark:group-focus/link:border-primary-light"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" fill="gray" height="12px" viewBox="0 0 576 512"><path d="M0 256C0 167.6 71.6 96 160 96h72c13.3 0 24 10.7 24 24s-10.7 24-24 24H160C98.1 144 48 194.1 48 256s50.1 112 112 112h72c13.3 0 24 10.7 24 24s-10.7 24-24 24H160C71.6 416 0 344.4 0 256zm576 0c0 88.4-71.6 160-160 160H344c-13.3 0-24-10.7-24-24s10.7-24 24-24h72c61.9 0 112-50.1 112-112s-50.1-112-112-112H344c-13.3 0-24-10.7-24-24s10.7-24 24-24h72c88.4 0 160 71.6 160 160zM184 232H392c13.3 0 24 10.7 24 24s-10.7 24-24 24H184c-13.3 0-24-10.7-24-24s10.7-24 24-24z"></path></svg></div></a></div><span class="cursor-pointer">Alert Thresholds</span></h4>
<span data-as="p">Set alert thresholds to receive notifications before your budget limit is reached:</span>
<ul>
<li>For cost-based budgets, set thresholds in USD</li>
<li>For token-based budgets, set thresholds in tokens</li>
<li>Receive email notifications when usage reaches the threshold</li>
<li>Continue using the key until the full budget limit is reached</li>
</ul>
<h4 class="flex whitespace-pre-wrap group font-semibold" id="periodic-reset-options"><div class="absolute" tabindex="-1"><a href="#periodic-reset-options" class="-ml-10 flex items-center opacity-0 border-0 group-hover:opacity-100 focus:opacity-100 focus:outline-0 group/link" aria-label="Navigate to header">​<div class="w-6 h-6 rounded-md flex items-center justify-center shadow-sm text-gray-400 dark:text-white/50 dark:bg-background-dark dark:brightness-[1.35] dark:ring-1 dark:hover:brightness-150 bg-white ring-1 ring-gray-400/30 dark:ring-gray-700/25 hover:ring-gray-400/60 dark:hover:ring-white/20 group-focus/link:border-2 group-focus/link:border-primary dark:group-focus/link:border-primary-light"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" fill="gray" height="12px" viewBox="0 0 576 512"><path d="M0 256C0 167.6 71.6 96 160 96h72c13.3 0 24 10.7 24 24s-10.7 24-24 24H160C98.1 144 48 194.1 48 256s50.1 112 112 112h72c13.3 0 24 10.7 24 24s-10.7 24-24 24H160C71.6 416 0 344.4 0 256zm576 0c0 88.4-71.6 160-160 160H344c-13.3 0-24-10.7-24-24s10.7-24 24-24h72c61.9 0 112-50.1 112-112s-50.1-112-112-112H344c-13.3 0-24-10.7-24-24s10.7-24 24-24h72c88.4 0 160 71.6 160 160zM184 232H392c13.3 0 24 10.7 24 24s-10.7 24-24 24H184c-13.3 0-24-10.7-24-24s10.7-24 24-24z"></path></svg></div></a></div><span class="cursor-pointer">Periodic Reset Options</span></h4>
<span data-as="p">Configure budget limits to automatically reset at regular intervals:</span>
<div><div data-name="frame" class="frame p-2 not-prose relative bg-gray-50/50 rounded-2xl overflow-hidden dark:bg-gray-800/25 print:print-color-exact"><div style="background-position:10px 10px" class="absolute inset-0 bg-grid-neutral-200/20 [mask-image:linear-gradient(0deg,#fff,rgba(255,255,255,0.6))] dark:bg-grid-white/5 dark:[mask-image:linear-gradient(0deg,rgba(255,255,255,0.1),rgba(255,255,255,0.5))] print:print-color-exact"></div><div class="relative rounded-xl overflow-hidden flex justify-center"><span aria-owns="rmiz-modal-" data-rmiz=""><span data-rmiz-content="not-found" style="visibility:visible"><img src="https://mintlify.s3.us-west-1.amazonaws.com/portkey-docs/images/product/periodic-reset.png" class=""/></span></span></div><div class="absolute inset-0 pointer-events-none border border-black/5 rounded-2xl dark:border-white/5"></div></div></div>
<span data-as="p"><strong>Reset Period Options:</strong></span>
<ul>
<li><strong>No Periodic Reset</strong>: The budget limit applies until exhausted with no automatic renewal</li>
<li><strong>Reset Weekly</strong>: Budget limits automatically reset every week</li>
<li><strong>Reset Monthly</strong>: Budget limits automatically reset every month</li>
</ul>
<span data-as="p"><strong>Reset Timing:</strong></span>
<ul>
<li>Weekly resets occur at the beginning of each week (Sunday at 12 AM UTC)</li>
<li>Monthly resets occur on the <strong>1st</strong> calendar day of the month, at <strong>12 AM UTC</strong>, irrespective of when the budget limit was set prior</li>
</ul>
<h3 class="flex whitespace-pre-wrap group font-semibold" id="rate-limits"><div class="absolute" tabindex="-1"><a href="#rate-limits" class="-ml-10 flex items-center opacity-0 border-0 group-hover:opacity-100 focus:opacity-100 focus:outline-0 group/link" aria-label="Navigate to header">​<div class="w-6 h-6 rounded-md flex items-center justify-center shadow-sm text-gray-400 dark:text-white/50 dark:bg-background-dark dark:brightness-[1.35] dark:ring-1 dark:hover:brightness-150 bg-white ring-1 ring-gray-400/30 dark:ring-gray-700/25 hover:ring-gray-400/60 dark:hover:ring-white/20 group-focus/link:border-2 group-focus/link:border-primary dark:group-focus/link:border-primary-light"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" fill="gray" height="12px" viewBox="0 0 576 512"><path d="M0 256C0 167.6 71.6 96 160 96h72c13.3 0 24 10.7 24 24s-10.7 24-24 24H160C98.1 144 48 194.1 48 256s50.1 112 112 112h72c13.3 0 24 10.7 24 24s-10.7 24-24 24H160C71.6 416 0 344.4 0 256zm576 0c0 88.4-71.6 160-160 160H344c-13.3 0-24-10.7-24-24s10.7-24 24-24h72c61.9 0 112-50.1 112-112s-50.1-112-112-112H344c-13.3 0-24-10.7-24-24s10.7-24 24-24h72c88.4 0 160 71.6 160 160zM184 232H392c13.3 0 24 10.7 24 24s-10.7 24-24 24H184c-13.3 0-24-10.7-24-24s10.7-24 24-24z"></path></svg></div></a></div><span class="cursor-pointer">Rate Limits</span></h3>
<span data-as="p">Rate limits control the velocity of API usage, protecting against runaway processes and ensuring fair resource distribution across teams.</span>
<h4 class="flex whitespace-pre-wrap group font-semibold" id="setting-rate-limits"><div class="absolute" tabindex="-1"><a href="#setting-rate-limits" class="-ml-10 flex items-center opacity-0 border-0 group-hover:opacity-100 focus:opacity-100 focus:outline-0 group/link" aria-label="Navigate to header">​<div class="w-6 h-6 rounded-md flex items-center justify-center shadow-sm text-gray-400 dark:text-white/50 dark:bg-background-dark dark:brightness-[1.35] dark:ring-1 dark:hover:brightness-150 bg-white ring-1 ring-gray-400/30 dark:ring-gray-700/25 hover:ring-gray-400/60 dark:hover:ring-white/20 group-focus/link:border-2 group-focus/link:border-primary dark:group-focus/link:border-primary-light"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" fill="gray" height="12px" viewBox="0 0 576 512"><path d="M0 256C0 167.6 71.6 96 160 96h72c13.3 0 24 10.7 24 24s-10.7 24-24 24H160C98.1 144 48 194.1 48 256s50.1 112 112 112h72c13.3 0 24 10.7 24 24s-10.7 24-24 24H160C71.6 416 0 344.4 0 256zm576 0c0 88.4-71.6 160-160 160H344c-13.3 0-24-10.7-24-24s10.7-24 24-24h72c61.9 0 112-50.1 112-112s-50.1-112-112-112H344c-13.3 0-24-10.7-24-24s10.7-24 24-24h72c88.4 0 160 71.6 160 160zM184 232H392c13.3 0 24 10.7 24 24s-10.7 24-24 24H184c-13.3 0-24-10.7-24-24s10.7-24 24-24z"></path></svg></div></a></div><span class="cursor-pointer">Setting Rate Limits</span></h4>
<ol>
<li>In your Integration settings, navigate to <strong>Workspace Provisioning</strong></li>
<li>Select which workspaces should have access:<!-- -->
<ul>
<li><strong>All Workspaces</strong>: Grants access to every workspace in your organization</li>
<li><strong>Specific Workspaces</strong>: Choose individual workspaces that need access</li>
</ul>
</li>
<li>Click on the  <code>Edit Budget &amp; Rate Limits</code> <svg class="icon inline bg-gray-800 dark:bg-gray-100" style="-webkit-mask-image:url(https://d3gk2c5xim1je2.cloudfront.net/v7.1.0/regular/pen-to-square.svg);-webkit-mask-repeat:no-repeat;-webkit-mask-position:center;mask-image:url(https://d3gk2c5xim1je2.cloudfront.net/v7.1.0/regular/pen-to-square.svg);mask-repeat:no-repeat;mask-position:center;width:24px;height:24px;display:inline-block;vertical-align:middle"></svg> icon to edit the rate limits for the selected workspace</li>
<li>Set your desired rate Limits</li>
<li>Optionally, Select the <code>Apply to every workspace where this integration is enabled</code> checkbox to apply the same rate limits to all workspaces where this integration is enabled</li>
</ol>
<h4 class="flex whitespace-pre-wrap group font-semibold" id="configuration-options"><div class="absolute" tabindex="-1"><a href="#configuration-options" class="-ml-10 flex items-center opacity-0 border-0 group-hover:opacity-100 focus:opacity-100 focus:outline-0 group/link" aria-label="Navigate to header">​<div class="w-6 h-6 rounded-md flex items-center justify-center shadow-sm text-gray-400 dark:text-white/50 dark:bg-background-dark dark:brightness-[1.35] dark:ring-1 dark:hover:brightness-150 bg-white ring-1 ring-gray-400/30 dark:ring-gray-700/25 hover:ring-gray-400/60 dark:hover:ring-white/20 group-focus/link:border-2 group-focus/link:border-primary dark:group-focus/link:border-primary-light"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" fill="gray" height="12px" viewBox="0 0 576 512"><path d="M0 256C0 167.6 71.6 96 160 96h72c13.3 0 24 10.7 24 24s-10.7 24-24 24H160C98.1 144 48 194.1 48 256s50.1 112 112 112h72c13.3 0 24 10.7 24 24s-10.7 24-24 24H160C71.6 416 0 344.4 0 256zm576 0c0 88.4-71.6 160-160 160H344c-13.3 0-24-10.7-24-24s10.7-24 24-24h72c61.9 0 112-50.1 112-112s-50.1-112-112-112H344c-13.3 0-24-10.7-24-24s10.7-24 24-24h72c88.4 0 160 71.6 160 160zM184 232H392c13.3 0 24 10.7 24 24s-10.7 24-24 24H184c-13.3 0-24-10.7-24-24s10.7-24 24-24z"></path></svg></div></a></div><span class="cursor-pointer">Configuration Options</span></h4>
<span data-as="p"><strong>Limit Types:</strong></span>
<ul>
<li><strong>Request-based</strong>: Limit number of API calls (e.g., 1000 requests/minute)</li>
<li><strong>Token-based</strong>: Limit token consumption rate (e.g., 1M tokens/hour)</li>
</ul>
<span data-as="p"><strong>Time Windows:</strong>
Choose from three different time intervals for your rate limits:</span>
<ul>
<li><strong>Per Minute</strong>: Limits reset every minute, ideal for fine-grained control</li>
<li><strong>Per Hour</strong>: Limits reset hourly, providing balanced usage control</li>
<li><strong>Per Day</strong>: Limits reset daily, suitable for broader usage patterns</li>
</ul>
<blockquote>
<h4 class="flex whitespace-pre-wrap group font-semibold" id="key-considerations-for-rate-limits"><div class="absolute" tabindex="-1"><a href="#key-considerations-for-rate-limits" class="-ml-10 flex items-center opacity-0 border-0 group-hover:opacity-100 focus:opacity-100 focus:outline-0 group/link" aria-label="Navigate to header">​<div class="w-6 h-6 rounded-md flex items-center justify-center shadow-sm text-gray-400 dark:text-white/50 dark:bg-background-dark dark:brightness-[1.35] dark:ring-1 dark:hover:brightness-150 bg-white ring-1 ring-gray-400/30 dark:ring-gray-700/25 hover:ring-gray-400/60 dark:hover:ring-white/20 group-focus/link:border-2 group-focus/link:border-primary dark:group-focus/link:border-primary-light"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" fill="gray" height="12px" viewBox="0 0 576 512"><path d="M0 256C0 167.6 71.6 96 160 96h72c13.3 0 24 10.7 24 24s-10.7 24-24 24H160C98.1 144 48 194.1 48 256s50.1 112 112 112h72c13.3 0 24 10.7 24 24s-10.7 24-24 24H160C71.6 416 0 344.4 0 256zm576 0c0 88.4-71.6 160-160 160H344c-13.3 0-24-10.7-24-24s10.7-24 24-24h72c61.9 0 112-50.1 112-112s-50.1-112-112-112H344c-13.3 0-24-10.7-24-24s10.7-24 24-24h72c88.4 0 160 71.6 160 160zM184 232H392c13.3 0 24 10.7 24 24s-10.7 24-24 24H184c-13.3 0-24-10.7-24-24s10.7-24 24-24z"></path></svg></div></a></div><span class="cursor-pointer">Key Considerations for Rate Limits</span></h4>
<ul>
<li>Rate limits can be set as either request-based or token-based</li>
<li>Time intervals can be configured as per minute, per hour, or per day</li>
<li>Setting the limit to 0 disables the provider</li>
<li>Rate limits apply immediately after being set</li>
<li>Once set, rate limits <strong>cannot be edited</strong> by any organization member</li>
<li>Rate limits work for <strong>all providers</strong> available on Portkey and apply to <strong>all organization members</strong> who use the provider</li>
<li>After a rate limit is reached, requests will be rejected until the time period resets</li>
</ul>
</blockquote>
<h4 class="flex whitespace-pre-wrap group font-semibold" id="use-cases-for-rate-limits"><div class="absolute" tabindex="-1"><a href="#use-cases-for-rate-limits" class="-ml-10 flex items-center opacity-0 border-0 group-hover:opacity-100 focus:opacity-100 focus:outline-0 group/link" aria-label="Navigate to header">​<div class="w-6 h-6 rounded-md flex items-center justify-center shadow-sm text-gray-400 dark:text-white/50 dark:bg-background-dark dark:brightness-[1.35] dark:ring-1 dark:hover:brightness-150 bg-white ring-1 ring-gray-400/30 dark:ring-gray-700/25 hover:ring-gray-400/60 dark:hover:ring-white/20 group-focus/link:border-2 group-focus/link:border-primary dark:group-focus/link:border-primary-light"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" fill="gray" height="12px" viewBox="0 0 576 512"><path d="M0 256C0 167.6 71.6 96 160 96h72c13.3 0 24 10.7 24 24s-10.7 24-24 24H160C98.1 144 48 194.1 48 256s50.1 112 112 112h72c13.3 0 24 10.7 24 24s-10.7 24-24 24H160C71.6 416 0 344.4 0 256zm576 0c0 88.4-71.6 160-160 160H344c-13.3 0-24-10.7-24-24s10.7-24 24-24h72c61.9 0 112-50.1 112-112s-50.1-112-112-112H344c-13.3 0-24-10.7-24-24s10.7-24 24-24h72c88.4 0 160 71.6 160 160zM184 232H392c13.3 0 24 10.7 24 24s-10.7 24-24 24H184c-13.3 0-24-10.7-24-24s10.7-24 24-24z"></path></svg></div></a></div><span class="cursor-pointer">Use Cases for Rate Limits</span></h4>
<ul>
<li><strong>Cost Control</strong>: Prevent unexpected usage spikes that could lead to high costs</li>
<li><strong>Performance Management</strong>: Ensure your application maintains consistent performance</li>
<li><strong>Fairness</strong>: Distribute API access fairly across teams or users</li>
<li><strong>Security</strong>: Mitigate potential abuse or DoS attacks</li>
<li><strong>Provider Compliance</strong>: Stay within the rate limits imposed by underlying AI providers</li>
</ul>
<h4 class="flex whitespace-pre-wrap group font-semibold" id="exceeding-rate-limits"><div class="absolute" tabindex="-1"><a href="#exceeding-rate-limits" class="-ml-10 flex items-center opacity-0 border-0 group-hover:opacity-100 focus:opacity-100 focus:outline-0 group/link" aria-label="Navigate to header">​<div class="w-6 h-6 rounded-md flex items-center justify-center shadow-sm text-gray-400 dark:text-white/50 dark:bg-background-dark dark:brightness-[1.35] dark:ring-1 dark:hover:brightness-150 bg-white ring-1 ring-gray-400/30 dark:ring-gray-700/25 hover:ring-gray-400/60 dark:hover:ring-white/20 group-focus/link:border-2 group-focus/link:border-primary dark:group-focus/link:border-primary-light"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" fill="gray" height="12px" viewBox="0 0 576 512"><path d="M0 256C0 167.6 71.6 96 160 96h72c13.3 0 24 10.7 24 24s-10.7 24-24 24H160C98.1 144 48 194.1 48 256s50.1 112 112 112h72c13.3 0 24 10.7 24 24s-10.7 24-24 24H160C71.6 416 0 344.4 0 256zm576 0c0 88.4-71.6 160-160 160H344c-13.3 0-24-10.7-24-24s10.7-24 24-24h72c61.9 0 112-50.1 112-112s-50.1-112-112-112H344c-13.3 0-24-10.7-24-24s10.7-24 24-24h72c88.4 0 160 71.6 160 160zM184 232H392c13.3 0 24 10.7 24 24s-10.7 24-24 24H184c-13.3 0-24-10.7-24-24s10.7-24 24-24z"></path></svg></div></a></div><span class="cursor-pointer">Exceeding Rate Limits</span></h4>
<span data-as="p">When a rate limit is reached:</span>
<ul>
<li>Subsequent requests are rejected with a specific error code</li>
<li>Error messages clearly indicate that the rate limit has been exceeded</li>
<li>The limit automatically resets after the specified time period has elapsed</li>
</ul>

When enabled, any version fields omitted from the request are backfilled from the current latest version, allowing you to update only the fields you need. When `patch` is omitted or `false`, all version fields must be provided together (original strict validation).\\n\\n**Metadata-only updates:** Fields like `name`, `collection_id`, `version_description`, and `virtual_key` can always be updated independently without affecting versioning.\\n\",\"href\":\"/api-reference/admin-api/control-plane/prompts/update-prompt\"},{\"title\":\"Delete Prompt\",\"openapi\":\"delete /prompts/{promptId}\",\"description\":null,\"href\":\"/api-reference/admin-api/control-plane/prompts/delete-prompt\"},{\"title\":\"Publish Prompt\",\"openapi\":\"put /prompts/{promptId}/makeDefault\",\"description\":null,\"href\":\"/api-reference/admin-api/control-plane/prompts/publish-prompt\"},{\"title\":\"List Prompt Versions\",\"openapi\":\"get /prompts/{promptId}/versions\",\"description\":null,\"href\":\"/api-reference/admin-api/control-plane/prompts/list-prompt-versions\"},{\"title\":\"Retrieve Prompt Version\",\"openapi\":\"get /prompts/{promptId}/versions/{versionId}\",\"description\":null,\"href\":\"/api-reference/admin-api/control-plane/prompts/retrieve-prompt-version\"},{\"title\":\"Update Prompt Version\",\"openapi\":\"put /prompts/{promptId}/versions/{versionId}\",\"description\":\"Updates metadata for a specific prompt version. **This endpoint only supports updating the `label_id` field.**\\n\\nPrompt versions are immutable — their `string`, `parameters`, and `model` content cannot be changed after creation.
